description: Machine-tools; punching, notching or nibbling machines (excluding presses) for flat products including combined punching and shearing machines, numerically controlled, for working metal

predecessors.note: Before 2022 numerically controlled punching and notching machines were HS 846241. The continuous long series is at HS-4 8462.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
